content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Verify your background meets these thresholds before enrolling. Fort Walton Beach's defense and aerospace sector, anchored by Eglin AFB and major contractors, values certified project managers—confirming eligibility is your first step forward.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our program delivers all required contact hours through interactive online sessions, allowing you to learn while managing your Fort Walton Beach career. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategy without traveling or disrupting your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including verification of your education and project experience. You'll also pay the PMI exam fee at this time. Our admissions team can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and strategy sessions to reinforce your readiness. You'll sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a PMI-authorized testing center. Our instructors, active certified practitioners, remain available to clarify concepts and boost your confidence before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or authoring. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses so you can sustain your certification and stay current in project-management practice.
